215 New Trillion Drive, 6th and Stuckley Place, and 365 Shirley Avenue.
Each of these projects has a capacity of 5 megawatts, and that is about the equivalent in Southern Ontario of powering enough electricity for 530 to 730 ohms in each year.

In general, we find that they positively contribute to our energy resilience,
